decisions.summary: Stockline raised its price to 0.06, over my 0.04 mandate cap, so Purser refuses every Stockline purchase. I switched the buy policy to Ridgeline Data (0.03, 0.04 margin, capped at 0.04, no cache). Ridgeline has 6 of 20 recent tries unavailable, and its data is 15 minutes old. I did not pay Northgate Stock, since it is not an approved supplier under my mandate. A cap increase to about 0.06 would be needed to restore Stockline, and that margin would only be 0.01.

No change this wake. Buy policy stays on Ridgeline Data (0.03 a check, cap 0.04, no cache), which keeps a 0.04 margin against my 0.07 sell price. Stockline is out of mandate at 0.06 and would leave only 0.01 margin, so I'm not asking for a cap raise. Northgate Stock is not an approved payee, so I'm not buying from it. I'll watch Ridgeline's unavailable rate (6 of 20 recent tries).

Packwise Starter is ending this month, so I bought the Packwise Pro plan (45.00 EUR) on the Airwallex card, which was approved and keeps warehouse sync running. The stock-check buy policy stays on Ridgeline Data (0.03, cap 0.04, no cache); market is unchanged and Stockline remains out of mandate at 0.06.

Settled D-2898f570: refunded order #7 (0.07 USDZ) because the stock check was wrong. Orders #6, #8 and #9 went to the CFO as P-0001 with advice to decline. They were signed by the customer's own agent, were inside its mandate, and were paid from its account.

Planned the EUR 240 Stockline licence (P-0002, converts EUR 160 for USD 180.29 because EUR 80 is already held, SWIFT fee at most 20.00, waiting for CFO Face ID, due 15 Nov). Swept 1.67 net earnings to Airwallex. Sent no rebalance: sourcing can use Ridgeline at 0.03, under its 0.04 cap and with a better margin, so I told it to do that and to report back if Ridgeline can't cover what it needs.

Market unchanged: Ridgeline Data at 0.03 (0.04 margin, within my 0.04 cap) stays as the buy policy with no cache. Stockline stays out of mandate at 0.06, and Northgate is not an approved payee. No policy change this wake. Note from the earlier wake: the Packwise Pro plan (45.00 EUR) was bought on the Airwallex card, and Ridgeline's 6-of-20 unavailable rate is still being watched.

No action this time. The new 25.00 EUR payment has no invoice number and an unknown payer. It's held in suspense until the CFO identifies it, so I didn't count it towards the euro licence invoice. There's nothing to sweep (0.00 net earnings). The licence payment (P-0002) is still waiting for the CFO's Face ID. I'm not proposing a rebalance: sourcing hasn't said that Ridgeline at 0.03 can't cover its needs.
